note: Recorded state of every migration in ops/migrations/. Migrations on this project are applied by hand and this file is the only place that says which ones have been. A state is a claim about the live database that a human established and can defend in a diff — never something this repository inferred for itself. States: applied (carries appliedOn — an ISO date, or the literal "unknown" where the date is genuinely unrecoverable), pending (carries reason), unknown (carries reason). "unknown" is a legitimate answer; a guess is not.

pi.venue_claims probed against the live PostgREST endpoint on 2026-09-14 returned HTTP 404 PGRST205, "Could not find the table 'pi.venue_claims' in the schema cache". A control probe of pi.venue_change_requests on the same endpoint with the same publishable key returned HTTP 200, so the endpoint and the key are good and the table is genuinely absent. The migration has therefore never run — the claim form at /partners/claim/ has been submitting into nothing since 2026-05-10. Evidence: JWR-TheOne 07-projects/peninsula-insider/deliverables/2026-09-14-pi-017-operator-access-gap-inventory.md.
